title: OpenProse account state (the result of cli auth login|status|logout)
description: The `result` of the openprose.service-operation/1 envelope of `cli auth login`, `cli auth status` and `cli auth logout`. On failure the envelope's result is null and problem.details names the key's source.

credentialSource.description: Where the API key came from: the environment variable, the operating system credential store, or none.

identity.description: `cli auth status`: who the key belongs to, when the service says (GET /organizations names a login). `organization` is the slug of the default organization, or null.
